selection: Read User 1 personas in source order until 50 distinct profiles remain (125 CSV data rows, zero-based 0..124). Normalize common contraction and wording variants before comparison. Collapse profiles when their fact sets are identical/reordered, one is a subset of the other, or they share at least 3 facts. Keep the most informative source row, breaking ties by earliest row; sort by source row and renumber IDs continuously. Translate sentences to Chinese without inferred facts.
translation: Source facts are manually translated in persona_translations_zh.json. Modern-life details in persona_expansions_zh.json are project-authored. Speech styles in persona_speech_styles_zh.json summarize User 1 utterances from the source's synthetic Best Generated Conversation column; dialogue claims are not added as persona facts.
speech_style_source: Best Generated Conversation / User 1 turns, matched by source_row_index
